icon:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: Google Play app icon for the Korean subtitle creation and editing app "해비 자막".
Primary request: Create one polished, flat, extremely clean icon. A full square solid near-black background #171717, opaque edge to edge. Center the approved Editorial Studio 1-B white framed subtitle glyph: a sturdy outlined rounded rectangular subtitle frame contains a small right-pointing play triangle at upper right, one long horizontal subtitle bar in the middle, and two separate shorter bars on the lower row. The mark uses simple substantial geometry and balanced generous negative space; no typography. The silhouette must remain clear at 48 pixels.
Composition: Square 1:1, 1024 by 1024 pixels, icon centered with a safe area of 16 percent around the white mark. Keep the triangle and all bars INSIDE the outlined subtitle frame. Do not substitute floating shapes without a frame; preserve the canonical 1-B silhouette.
Style: Monochrome minimal professional software identity, flat filled vector-like raster geometry. Match an app UI with black buttons, gray borders and white surfaces.
Constraints: no text, no letters, no extra rounded background card (the subtitle mark itself contains a frame), no transparent area, no gradient, no shadow, no glow, no bevel, no border, no smartphone, no badge, no watermark, no extra objects. Full opaque square black background.

Primary request: A refined minimal typographic banner for a real subtitle creation/editing app. Light neutral gray-white background, near-black text, sparse precise composition. Flat monochrome visual identity; no gradients or decorative effects.
Text verbatim:
"해비 자막" (large bold Korean main title at left)
"영상과 음성을 자막으로" (clear smaller Korean tagline below title)
"생성 · 편집 · 내보내기" (compact supporting line below)
Right side: one large near-black framed subtitle glyph matching the approved app icon: a rounded rectangular outline holds a right-pointing play triangle in its upper right, one long middle subtitle bar, and two separated shorter bars below. Do not replace it with an unframed triangle and floating bars.
Composition: Left 62% title and supporting text, right 30% mark, ample breathing room, all critical content within 10% outer safe margins. Precise Korean typography, black text, balanced baseline alignment, professional Korean software brand.
Constraints: no smartphone, no app interface, no reconstruction of UI, no additional text, no promotional prices, no claims about free/unlimited/translation accuracy, no badges, no transparent region, no gradient, no shadow, no glow, no 3D, no extra rounded cards or exterior frames beyond the internal subtitle-frame mark, no watermarks. The exact three Korean text lines must be spelled correctly. Full opaque clean background.
